payload.title: 论文理论章节 v1：Def.1/Prop.1/Def.2/Prop.2/Rem.1/Def.3/Thm.1/Cor.1/Prop.3 正式化 + 数值验证

payload.scope: Paper theory section v1: Def.1 (history-conditioned low-rank Koopman family), Prop.1 (finite-history Markovization), Def.2 (latent rollout inconsistency), Prop.2 (error propagation), Rem.1 (spectral stabilization insufficient), Def.3 (rollout-aware training), Thm.1 (finite-horizon error bound), Cor.1 (physical error), Prop.3 (RTI local approximation), scope/non-goals, numerical validation.
payload.honesty_bounds: All results finite-horizon only; no global Koopman stability, no common Lyapunov, no global asymptotic closed-loop stability, no recursive feasibility. Thm.1 bound and Cor.1 bound reported as valid-but-loose. Prop.1 holds only for the predictor's internal rollout. Prop.3 is classical Taylor remainder, not new SQP theory.
payload.status: v1 draft complete; independent verification review delegated (in progress)
